intro.title: Styled Component Pattern
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple, reusable button component using the Styled Component Pattern. This pattern allows you to write actual CSS code directly within your TypeScript components to style them. You will learn how to use the `styled` function from the 'styled-components' library to create styled elements. By the end, you will understand how to apply and customize styles in a type-safe and component-scoped way in React with TypeScript.
intro.usecase: The Styled Component Pattern is widely used in modern React applications to build maintainable and scalable design systems. You'll see it in product dashboards where consistent, themeable buttons and cards are needed, or in complex forms where input fields and validation messages require specific, reusable styling. It's essential for creating interactive UI components like modals, navigation bars, and data tables that adapt to different themes or states without CSS conflicts. This pattern helps developers keep styling logic colocated with components, making it easier to manage in large codebases like e-commerce sites or admin panels.
